process.heading: Grown for your order, not for a shelf.

seed.title: Untreated seed
seed.body: We buy only non-treated seed — no chemical coating, nothing you would not want on a plate.

quality.title: Checked for quality
quality.body: Every batch is examined before it goes anywhere near a tray. Poor seed means poor greens.

sown.title: Sown on your order
sown.body: Nothing is sown speculatively. Your order decides what goes into the trays that Sunday.

harvest.title: Harvested to deliver
harvest.body: Cut on Saturday morning and taken straight to your door. No cold room in between.

otherProducts.heading: Grow your own, or eat them ready-made.
otherProducts.body: Ordered any time and delivered on the same Saturday run as the greens.

neverFrozen.title: Never frozen
neverFrozen.note: Cut and delivered the same morning
